name: rem_dream
description: Periodic REM memory assimilation over recent visible inputs and outputs.
prompt: Assimilate the short-term slice. Search existing memories before adding. Keep durable facts, preferences, decisions, identities, unresolved work. Drop obsolete bloat. End with one JSON object on its own line: {"actions": {"ltm_add": ["fact"], "ltm_remove": [<line ids>], "shared_add": [{"scope": "global|user:<id>|guild:<id>|channel:<id>", "content": "fact", "importance": 1-10}]}, "audit": "one-paragraph summary"}. If nothing to persist: {"actions": {}, "audit": "no changes"}. audit is required.
